predecessors.name: Kazakh Khanate
predecessors.text: Tashkent, part of the Kazakh Khanate 'between 1598 and 1723' (TK); in 1784 it was four rival quarters until Yunus Khoja won

successors.name: Khanate of Kokand
successors.text: Tashkent 'annexed to the Khanate of Kokand' in 1809

ledger.x: 1798: the Kazakh steppes of the Senior Jüz are conquered.

wars.name: Kokand conquest of Tashkent
wars.outcome: Kokand occupied Tashkent (1808 on YK) and annexed it (1809 on TK); the state ended.

certainty.note: The oasis edge and the steppe authority are described, not surveyed; the Syr Darya bounds the south and west.
